output.title: gitwhisper – AI Commit Messages
output.tagline: Conventional Commits drafted from your staged diff in 2 seconds
output.description_short: gitwhisper reads your staged diff and writes a Conventional Commit message — plus a PR description. 18,000 installs, 4.6 stars. Local Ollama model supported.
output.description_long:
**Stop writing commit messages by hand.**

gitwhisper lives inside VS Code, reads your staged diff, and drafts a Conventional Commit message before you can reach for the keyboard. Need a PR description too? One more click — same diff analysis, no extra work.

**Why developers choose gitwhisper:**
- **Per-repo style learning** — scans your last 200 commits so the output matches your team's conventions, not a generic template.
- **Local-model mode** — point it at a local Ollama model and your diffs never leave the machine. Essential for teams with data-residency rules.
- **Fast** — under 2 seconds with a 3B local model; cloud mode is faster still.

**Trusted by 18,000 developers** with a 4.6-star average from 210 Marketplace reviews.

Free tier covers commit message generation. **Pro ($4/month)** adds PR description drafting and the per-repo style-learning engine — worth it the first time your CI rejects a `wip` commit.

Your future self will thank you for the commit history.
screenshot_order: 1st — Show the extension generating a Conventional Commit message from a real staged diff in the VS Code Source Control panel; proves the core job in one glance.
2nd — Show the PR description output side-by-side with the commit message from the same diff; demonstrates the dual-output differentiator.
3rd — Show the Ollama local-model settings panel with a latency readout under 2 seconds; addresses the privacy/speed objection directly.

faq.q: Does gitwhisper send my code to the cloud?
faq.a: Only if you choose a cloud model. Switch to Ollama in settings and your diffs stay entirely on your machine.

faq.q: Will it match my team's commit style?
faq.a: Pro tier scans your last 200 commits and adapts output to your repo's conventions — not a one-size-fits-all template.

faq.q: What does the free tier include?
faq.a: Commit message generation for every staged diff, unlimited. PR descriptions and style learning require the $4/month Pro plan.

faq.q: Does it work with commit-lint or Conventional Commits CI checks?
faq.a: Yes — messages follow the Conventional Commits spec by default, so they pass commit-lint rules out of the box.
Not yet — VS Code only for now. JetBrains support is the most-requested feature and is on the roadmap.

output.cta: Install free — your first Conventional Commit is one click away.
